_doc: Drills graded on HOW they are solved, not only on the output. See tool_requirements.py. One group per concept; a qid may appear in one group only.

groups.why: Seth 2026-10-05: pooling drills must be solved with einops.reduce, or the learner practises reshape+mean instead of the factored-axis pattern.

Plain-PyTorch twin of einops.pooling (Seth 2026-10-05: the learner has to learn both). An einops one-liner here skips the reshape this concept drills. It must also split with .reshape or .view, so a Python loop does not stand in for the skill.
